design: 32 E2B units (layers 13-14: 8 turn neurons by write variance + 8 random each), 6 strongest tokens per pole, shuffled; two blind LM raters (r1 Opus, r2 Sonnet); scores 1-5 per pole, one_job yes/no

r1.pos_label: function words in clauses about a person's career events (after/because of/when)
r1.neg_label: mid-token in names and year digits / 'the' before numbers

r2.pos_label: function words/tokens after a verb/clause start about a person (his, he, when, by)

r1.pos_label: prepositions/complements after a participle or verb (dating to, relegated to, brought in by)
r1.neg_label: temporal/sequence conjunctions joining a later clause ('before', 'while')

r2.pos_label: prepositions/particles after participle (to, of, in, by)

r1.pos_label: alternate-name / gloss markers after a title (also known as, 'or', parentheses)
r1.neg_label: subword pieces inside names or compounds

r2.neg_label: mid-name word pieces / hyphen in names

r1.pos_label: punctuation/clause boundaries (commas, periods)
r1.neg_label: commas/conjunctions at clause or list boundaries

r1.pos_label: first token inside a parenthetical after a name (native-script name or birth date)
r1.neg_label: tokens in lists / coordinated items (and, ranges, upstream/downstream)

r1.pos_label: space token before a number (dates/years after 'Month day,')
r1.neg_label: 'the' following a verb/preposition

r2.pos_label: space token before a year digits after a date

r1.pos_label: subword continuation in rare proper names
r1.neg_label: tokens just after an entity name (head noun, 'is', ')')

r2.pos_label: mid-word pieces of rare foreign names/nouns

r1.pos_label: third digit of a year after '19' (decade digit)
r1.neg_label: first digit of a year after a space token

r1.pos_label: nationality/descriptor words in biographical lede ('South Korean', 'mixed martial')
r1.neg_label: none (dates, plurals, misc)

r1.pos_label: first token of a surname after a comma/sentence start, or century digit
r1.neg_label: none

r2.pos_label: first letter of surname after comma; year digit

r1.pos_label: formatting artifacts: RTL marks, list bullets, '\n' escapes
r1.neg_label: sentence-initial or function tokens after a sentence/name boundary

r1.pos_label: subword continuation pieces in mid-word
r1.neg_label: second subword of a first name at document start

r1.pos_label: verbs/auxiliaries in general descriptive sentences
r1.neg_label: nationality/'former' descriptors in athlete biography lede

r2.pos_label: auxiliary/linking words after a subject noun phrase

r1.pos_label: sports league/competition names
r1.neg_label: 'also' and tokens adjacent to 'also'

r1.pos_label: title tokens at the start of an article (The 2012 [X])
r1.neg_label: 'pay-per-view' pieces / multi-token compounds

r2.pos_label: event title words after year (Northern, Australian)

r1.pos_label: content words (nouns/participles) in descriptive phrases
r1.neg_label: prepositions/articles after verbs of motion or naming

r2.neg_label: preposition/the before noun (to, from, by, the)

r1.pos_label: sport/category noun completing a descriptor phrase (football, hockey, Grade II)
r1.neg_label: first digit of a number after 'in'/space

r2.pos_label: sport/role words after American/former (football, hockey, defensive)

r1.pos_label: none (end-of-name / punctuation tokens)
r1.neg_label: head noun / article right after 'is a' in definition

r2.neg_label: generic noun after 'is a' (list, asteroid, race)

r1.pos_label: third digit of a 20xx year
r1.neg_label: 'the' after a preposition

r1.pos_label: token right after the subject/parenthetical in a lede ('was', 'a')
r1.neg_label: first token of the document (start of a name)

r2.neg_label: first token of a person name at text start

r1.pos_label: none
r1.neg_label: tokens in alternate/foreign-name glosses

r1.pos_label: subword/internal pieces of proper names (institutions, places)
r1.neg_label: function words in sports/college biography (drafted by, graduated from)

r2.neg_label: preposition/verb after player bio (was drafted by, graduated from)

r1.pos_label: none
r1.neg_label: last digit of a year in birth/death date

r1.pos_label: tokens in dates/biographical lede
r1.neg_label: function words/punctuation mid-sentence

r1.pos_label: taxonomic species description (genus/family, 'is found in')
r1.neg_label: first digit of a year after a day/month

r2.pos_label: taxonomy-stub sentence words (genus of fungi, found in)
r2.neg_label: first digit of year after date

r1.pos_label: none
r1.neg_label: pronouns / articles at start of second sentence of a biography

r2.neg_label: sentence-start pronoun/the in athlete bio (He, Her, the)

r1.pos_label: space token before a number (years/channel numbers)
r1.neg_label: mixed; some space-before-number tokens

r1.pos_label: none (sentence boundaries in sports text)
r1.neg_label: racehorse lede tokens (foaling date, 'champion Australia')

r2.neg_label: tokens around thoroughbred birth date parentheses

r1.pos_label: adjectives/adverb modifiers before a noun (celebrated, much, heavily)
r1.neg_label: preposition after verb 'played/plays' in career description

r2.pos_label: adjectives/adverbs modifying a noun (celebrated, much, rather, heavily)

r1.pos_label: geographic locations (coasts, regions, states)

r1.neg_label: category noun or article after 'is a' in definition sentence

r2.neg_label: 'is a' and noun after (a, radio, restaurant)
